name: Page control (iOS)
summary: A row of dots showing which page of a short sequence you are on, such as onboarding or a photo carousel.

anatomy.purpose: One dot per page. The current one is darker.
Each dot says which page it is.

whenNotToUse: Long sets: use a scrubber or list.

keyboard: Tab to the dots; Enter or Space jumps to a page.
Left and right arrows move between dots.
accessibility.focus: The current page is marked with aria-current.
notes: Never rely on color alone: size or shape can differ too.
Provide previous and next controls for the content.
